message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine which charge(s) apply to the fact.

Fact: In 2015, defendant Gao sold counterfeit currency (fake RMB) to Guo. He sold total face value 100,000 yuan in 100-yuan notes, for price 12,000 yuan. He later returned 12,000 yuan (maybe restitution). The crime is dealing with counterfeit currency. The lexicon includes "持有、使用假币" (possession, use of counterfeit currency). Also maybe "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" but that's about forging documents, not currency. There's also "假冒注册商标" but not relevant. So the appropriate charge is "持有、使用假币". The fact is about selling counterfeit money, which is "持有、使用假币". The lexicon includes that exact string.

Thus answer: [罪名]持有、使用假币<eoa>

Check if any other charge applies: maybe "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" not. "生产、销售假药" not. So only one.

Thus final answer.
